Author: rebelmike
Content:
I've not used this setting before.  I notice that on the 1x1 where Andrew made the change, the ground vias have kept their annular rings on the inner layers (and in the pcb file there's `(zone_layer_connections "In1.Cu" "In2.Cu")`), but in your change to the quarter slot they are gone and no vias have those zone layer connections listed.  Similarly if I set annular rings to start, end and connected then I lose the inner layer rings.

I don't think this is actually important because the ground flood on the inner layers goes right through the vias, but I'm not 100% sure and it is weird.
